text_block_list.text:
The day of the Tokyo Daishoten is here,
and Oi
Racecourse is looking livelier
than usual!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Смарт Фалкон has really caught my eye!
text_block_list.name: Fan A

text_block_list.text:
Same. This is my first dirt race. Wonder
how she
looks when she's running. I
already know she's
super cute onstage!
text_block_list.name: Fan B

text_block_list.text: Hey, it's Falco! Good luck!
text_block_list.name: Falco Fan A

text_block_list.text:
I'm cheering for you! And I can't wait to
see you
sing!
text_block_list.name: Falco Fan B

text_block_list.text: ...Thanks so much, you guys! ☆
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
Follow me until the very end and
beyond. ☆
Smart Falcon, taking
flight! ♪
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text: Wooo!
text_block_list.name: Fans

text_block_list.text:
I thought she would be over the moon
seeing all
this hype before the race,
but...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Смарт Фалкон seems to be struggling to

concentrate. Her chitchat lacks its usual
zing.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Huh?
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
Oh, it's nothing! It's not like I'm worried
about
anything...
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
It's just... More people are coming,
right?
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
It's still early, so... I'm sure there'll be
more
people coming later.
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон
choice_data_list: There's a lot more people here than usual.

text_block_list.text:
Смарт Фалкон's growing popularity is
having an
effect on the popularity of dirt
races as a whole.
In other words...
text_block_list.name: Монолог
choice_data_list: Your hard work is paying off.

text_block_list.text:
...Haha, I'd sure be happy if that were
the case. ☆
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
At least... we did everything we could
possibly do.
No stone unturned.
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
It's almost time for the race to start, and
Smart
Falcon is looking increasingly
nervous.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Hey, Trainer. How many people are
there now?
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон
choice_data_list: It's looking to be over thirty thousand now.

text_block_list.text:
Seeing how fixated Смарт Фалкон has
been on the
audience numbers, I
checked them with the
organizers. I tell
her how delighted the staff were.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Thirty thousand... That's unreal. And...
how many
were at the Arima Kinen? Just
out of curiosity.
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон
choice_data_list: Around a hundred and ten thousand, I think.

text_block_list.text: One hundred and... Th-that many?!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
I get it now. Those numbers are like...
day and
night.
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
The Tokyo Daishoten is the final race of
the year.
It gets a lot more attention
than the other dirt
races.
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
Plus, a bunch of my fans are here to see
me this
year.
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
Yet, despite all of that... it just doesn't
compare.
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
I suppose she feels a little disappointed
in the
turnout, having just experienced
the immense
scale of the Arima Kinen
firsthand.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
choice_data_list:
I think you should stop focusing on the
numbers.

text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон
choice_data_list:
You can't afford to be distracted during the
race.

text_block_list.text:
The Tokyo Daishoten hosts the strongest
runners
regardless of age. Смарт Фалкон
won't be able to
win if her eyes aren't
fixed firmly on the prize.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: ...Yeah, you're right.
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
Sorry about that! I guess I'm just
stressing myself
out.
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
I've done everything I can. There's no
changing
things now.
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
I need to kick these thoughts to the curb
and aim
for center stage!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
...Don't you worry! There's nothing on my
mind
now except the center!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон
choice_data_list: Let's finish this year on a high note!

text_block_list.text: Right!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон
